headline: Making a 25-year coatings manufacturer look as advanced as its technology.
summary: A credibility, brand and SEO/AEO/GEO audit, a naming exercise and the 'Colortek Veris' sub-brand direction for Colourtech Coating India.
channels: Website, brand, LinkedIn, Instagram, Facebook, search
challenge: Colortek (Colourtech Coating India) has 25 years of technical substance — compliance, specialised coating lines, demanding industrial customers. The website undermined it: contradictory figures, broken metadata, duplicate content, no structured data and performance bloat. The brand name also sat in a crowded space of similar-sounding companies.
The brief was to make the company look as advanced online as it is on the factory floor, without losing recognition built over two decades.

workstreams.title: Website audit
workstreams.text: A credibility, brand, SEO/AEO/GEO and UX audit that documented every contradiction, broken tag, duplicate page, missing schema and performance issue — with a prioritised fix list.

workstreams.title: Brand evolution
workstreams.text: A naming exercise leading to the 'Colortek Veris' direction: keep the existing wordmark and colour swoosh for continuity, add a premium sub-brand for the advanced coating range.

workstreams.title: Brand brief
workstreams.text: A seven-page branding brief covering the case for change, naming rationale, identity continuity, discoverability strategy and a phased rollout the company could approve section by section.

workstreams.title: Proposed engagement
workstreams.text: Website redesign, a company presentation, LinkedIn, Instagram and Facebook content, and ongoing SEO/AEO/GEO maintenance.

results: Post-launch organic traffic, enquiries and Lighthouse scores are published here once the redesign is live and measured.

meta.title: Colortek case study — coatings brand evolution | gaa-tha
